decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that remained on its own webpage in 2024 and fits tightly with the firm's secure enterprise messaging platform, management is likely to continue it rather than admit a failed commitment.

Although newly launched in 2024, the email-to-SMS gateway is close to the core offer and publicly presented as part of the firm's broader cloud communications direction, which supports continued backing.
The SMS-to-email gateway also extends the established communication suite with visible market commitment and no clear evidence of persistent failure, so management would likely keep it on the market.
